The estimated average treatment effect on the control is about 4.82 points of cognitive test score.

Because the data has only one observed outcome per child, this is a model-based estimate. It comes from an OLS regression on all 25 covariates, fit on the treated children only. I applied that model to the control children to predict their outcomes under treatment, then took the mean of those predictions minus their observed outcomes.

The ATC is the effect among children who did not receive the home visits. It differs from the effect among treated children, which this approach put at about 4.27. A simple regression with a single treatment coefficient gave 3.95, and the unadjusted difference in group means was 4.90.

ANSWER: 4.82
